text:
jess: Heads-up — hitting a nasty replay edge with python async client and idempotency tokens.
jess: Flow: POST /v1/jobs with idempotency_key header -> transient 502 -> client retries but drops idempotency header on second attempt. Server creates duplicate job.
andre: oof. can you paste minimal repro?
jess: Yep. Async client snippet: 
```python
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')) as c:
    headers = {'Idempotency-Key': job_id}
    await c.post('/v1/jobs', json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)
```
jess: When transport raises aiohttp.ServerDisconnectedError, our retry wrapper re-sends but uses a fresh Request object that doesn't merge the original headers.
rahul: Is this only async or also sync?
jess: Confirmed on async; sync client seems to preserve headers because it reuses PreparedRequest. Async path constructs a new request through the session API.
marie: Any stack/trace?
jess: Quick log: 
```
WARNING retry: attempt=1 url=/v1/jobs error=502
INFO request: sending attempt=2 headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ***'}
```
Notice Idempotency-Key missing on attempt 2.
andre: Hmm. I think our RetryPolicy currently stores only method/url/body/timeout but not headers in the replay token. We should add headers whitelist (auth should be sanitized though).
marie: +1. We must be careful not to replay sensitive ephemeral headers (cookie/authorization may be okay if known safe). For idempotency keys we need to always preserve.
rahul: Proposed quick fix: attach original headers to the RetryContext and ensure _rebuild_request merges them before sending. Also add test that simulates transient 5xx and asserts no duplicate resource created.
jess: I'll open a draft PR. Also request: can we expose a configurable header_whitelist on client init so apps can opt-in which headers to persist for replays? Some libs call it allow_replay_headers.
andre: Good idea. Small API: RedwoodAsyncClient(..., replay_headers=["Idempotency-Key"]). Default empty (safer).
marie: For backward compat, we should include our standard idempotency header by default. I think most SDK users expect it.
andre: Hmm risk/compat. Maybe default=['Idempotency-Key'] but doc it explicitly.
rahul: Also add typing: make RetryContext.headers: Optional[Dict[str,str]] in our stubs so mypy catches misuse.
jess: I will add tests: one unit test to assert headers forwarded, one integration-ish that hits staging-idempotency endpoint to ensure no duplicate ▲.
dev-bot: new_issue created: GH#4821 — "python-async: preserve idempotency header during retry/replay" (assigned to jess) :tada:
jess: Thanks — will include changelog note and example in docs/samples/retries.md showing both sync and async patterns and recommended retry header whitelist.
andre: FYI add a note in release notes about behavior change so infra teams audit any custom headers they relied on.
marie: Nice catch. If you want a second pair of eyes on the PR ping me. :thumbsup:
